in_marathi.name: LakshmiMenon
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fortune, Prosperity, Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: LakshmiMenon हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. Menon is a common surname in India, derived from the Malayalam word ‘man’ meaning man. Thus, LakshmiMenon is a name that signifies the divine blessings of wealth and prosperity, and is commonly found among Hindu families.
